title: Marketplace integration handoff (Asana -> Partner Ops)
content:
Daily scratchpad — Asana -> Partner Ops handoff

Context:
- Goal: turn Asana onboarding board items into a concise Partner Ops checklist for SentiCo (marketplace listing + integration test).
- Current phase: pre-launch validation; partner devs are testing OAuth flow and example prompts.

Top priorities for today (quick bullets):
1) Confirm OAuth redirect URI on SentiCo side (waiting on SentiCo PR) — blocker until 14:00 PT.
2) Run integration smoke tests against staging (token rotation + KV cache sanity). SHARD-7 job.
3) Prepare minimal launch messaging for marketplace listing (50–100 words) and one image placeholder.
4) Update Asana tasks: move "integration smoke" -> In Review when tests pass.

Checklist (to convert into Partner Ops template):
- [ ] Verify partner app client ID/secret stored in Secrets manager and permissions scoped to /inference:generate
- [ ] Validate redirect URIs (prod + staging) match listing
- [ ] Run 3 smoke scenarios: chat response, streaming, embeddings => attach logs
- [ ] Confirm webhooks for usage events (backfill if missing)
- [ ] Confirm billing tier and dedicated capacity request if >100 rps
- [ ] Prepare rollback plan: model fallback list (gpt-compat-1, gpt-lite-1)

Quick notes / outcomes from last Slack thread (#partners-sentiCo):
- Ben: will open PR to change redirect uri by EOD.
- Maya: added embedding test dataset to /sentiCo/emb-tests.csv (need to copy to sandbox).
- SentiCo dev: will test token rotation script and send logs by 11:30 PT.

Blockers & mitigation:
- Blocker: Redirect URI mismatch. Mitigation: Confirm staging URI and deploy temporary redirect through proxy as fallback.
- Blocker: Missing usage webhook for embedding events. Mitigation: temporary polling job: poll /usage every 15m and emit events to partner-ops slack.

Messages (short drafts):
- Marketplace blurb (short): "SentiCo insights — Native embeddings + chat for sentiment-aware features. Fast inference with low-latency caching. Try the SentiCo demo in Redwood Marketplace."
- Onboarding email subject: "Welcome to Redwood Marketplace — next steps to connect SentiCo"
  Body: "Hi <Name>, thanks for connecting SentiCo. To finish setup: 1) confirm OAuth redirect; 2) provide sandbox API key; 3) run the smoke test script attached. Ping me if you hit CORS errors. — Avery"

Tasks for next sync (15:00 PT):
- Move any Asana tasks that passed into "In Review" and tag eng-oncall if smoke tests fail.
- Upload smoke test artifacts to the partner folder and fill the "integration-run" template.
- Draft marketplace listing assets and ask design for thumbnail (target: 03/15).

Notes to self (TODO style):
- Trim this doc and paste core checklist into Confluence under Partners/SentiCo/integration-checklist.
- Follow up with Maya about embedding dataset format (parquet vs csv).
- Save logs to S3: s3://redwood-partner-logs/sentiCo/2026-03-13/

One-liner status for standup: "SentiCo: redirect URI pending PR, staging smoke tests queued, marketplace blurb drafted, blocking webhook for embeddings (polling fallback enabled)."

Random scratch ideas (capture):
- Could we add an automatic check that validates redirect URIs when a partner submits listing? Small lambda triggered on Asana move.
- Consider a "quick test" SDK that runs the three smoke scenarios and outputs a single pass/fail to reduce manual steps.

End of scratchpad. Will prune and formalize after 15:00 sync.
